text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
CANAL ZONE

By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code, approved June 19, 1934, and as President of the United States, Executive Order No. 2006 of July 30, 1914, placing certain land in the Canal Zone, at Darien, under the control of the Secretary of the Navy for use as a naval radio station, is hereby revoked, and such land returned to the control and jurisdiction of the Governor of The Panama Canal.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

The White House,

September 11, 1939.
